checks.method: Inspected replay_r15_rho6_tree.py and executed the centrally authorized cycle5 replay with existing negative controls under timeout 30s. Exact command, hashes and limits are in checks/round07/alpha/manifest.json.
checks.observation: Exit 0 after 0.63 seconds: 5,109 nodes, 170,054 colour pairs, zero solutions. Wrong target, omitted child and wrong producer identity were rejected. The checker enforces literal scope, complete colour partitions, conflict witnesses, branch-child correspondence and reachability; the omitted branch prefix is bounded by its remaining-minus-one colour classes. These checks address silent branch loss rather than trusting a producer PASS. Only this tree was rerun; three corruptions do not establish universal checker correctness, and the ordinary support reduction remains separate.

checks.method: Read LOW15-A3-cover-independent-bridge.md and independently tested every choice of zero, one or two I7 vertices identified with Q8 leaves, using literal three-member sunflower detection and no producer imports.
checks.observation: All 183 identifications were checked; exactly 13 survive. Safe vertices are empty for H0,H1,H3,H4,H5, {0} for H2,H6, and {5,6} for H7. The point-link intersection criterion agrees with every test. A second Q8 member cannot create an omitted mixed obstruction because two Q8 members already meet in the separated core. This verifies the gluing domain conditional on the I7 catalogue and core-separation argument, not a new classification theorem. Script and output are preserved in checks/round07/alpha/.
